headword: {定番商品|ていばんしょうひん}
gloss: standard product; staple item; perennial seller

definitions.gloss: standard product; staple item; perennial seller
definitions.explanation: A product that remains consistently popular and is always kept in stock. Unlike seasonal or trendy items, a staple product has enduring demand.

examples.japanese: この{靴|くつ}はブランドの{定番商品|ていばんしょうひん}だ。
examples.english: These shoes are one of the brand's staple products.

examples.japanese: {定番商品|ていばんしょうひん}は{年間|ねんかん}を{通|つう}じて{売|う}れる。
examples.english: Standard products sell throughout the year.

examples.japanese: {季節限定|きせつげんてい}ではなく、{定番商品|ていばんしょうひん}として{定着|ていちゃく}した{味|あじ}もある。
examples.english: Some flavors have become established as standard products rather than seasonal limited editions.

notes:
Composed of {定番|ていばん} (standard, classic) and {商品|しょうひん} (product, goods). {定番|ていばん} originally comes from kabuki theater, where it referred to a fixed program or repertoire.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定番商品|ていばんしょうひん}を{揃|そろ}える: to stock standard products
- {定番商品|ていばんしょうひん}として{定着|ていちゃく}する: to become established as a staple
- {定番商品|ていばんしょうひん}のラインナップ: lineup of standard products

RELATED WORDS:
- {定番|ていばん}: standard, classic, go-to (can modify many nouns beyond products)
- {新商品|しんしょうひん}: new product
- {限定商品|げんていしょうひん}: limited-edition product
- {売|う}れ{筋商品|すじしょうひん}: best-selling product
